IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: production errors spike after recent canary deploy. Service: text-generation. Error pattern: KMS decrypt failures. Paging @Amy (oncall) and SRE rotation. Root TS: 2204506789
Amy (oncall): Acknowledged. looking. Can anyone drop quick customer-impact numbers?
Jo (cust-success): I'm seeing a handful of customer tickets about 502s for model endpoints in us-east-1. ~12 customers reporting. I'll collate IDs and escalate to account owners.
Ben (sre): On it. I'm pulling logs from canary pods now. If this is KMS-related we should kill the feature flag and roll back the canary.
Ryan (eng): FYI the deploy included a config change: switching key alias from alias/redwood-prod-1 -> alias/redwood-rotation-2026 as part of key rotation. That was gated behind a feature flag for the new KMS path.
Lina (prodops): DeployBot shows canary completed 02:22:13 UTC then gradual roll to 20% traffic. We have metrics for ~10m window.
Amy (oncall): Logs snippet from pod-3: ```ERROR com.redwood.kms.KmsClient - Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/ecsTaskRole is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/abcd-rotated```
Ben (sre): That's the expected error. Looks like new key's policy doesn't include the task role. Likely the new key got created with a restrictive policy during rotation.
Ryan (eng): Confirmed. I checked the rotation PR — we updated alias but didn't copy the key policy. Ops script expected key policy to be templated; the templating step failed silently.
Amy (oncall): Immediate mitigation: flip feature flag off (stop using new KMS alias) and rollback canary to previous config. Who can flip the flag now?
Lina (prodops): I can toggle flags. Doing it now via flags-console -> feature.kms_new_alias -> OFF. Link: https://flags.redwood.internal/feature.kms_new_alias (internal only)
Lina (prodops): toggled -> OFF :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: Feature flag change recorded by Lina at 02:35:10 UTC. Change id: ff-2204506900. No automated rollout triggered.
Amy (oncall): Traffic routing shows canary traffic falling back. Error rate trending down but still some errors from pods that used the new key. We'll need to restart those tasks or fully rollback the deployment.
Ben (sre): Recommend full rollback of the canary revision to prevent any stragglers. Amy, want me to run rollback now?
Amy (oncall): Please do. Post the command you run so it's auditable.
Ben (sre): Running: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/text-gen --to-revision=56```
Ben (sre): Rolling back. Watching pods come up. New pods healthy. Error rate back to baseline for 95% of traffic.
Ryan (eng): I'll validate KMS policies for the rotated key. Quick check: ```aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd-rotated --policy-name default | jq .Statement[].Principal``` shows missing "arn:aws:iam::111:role/ecsTaskRole" entry.
Ryan (eng): Proposed fix: update key policy to include the task role and the service account, then re-enable flag after verification. I'll prepare a policy patch and post for approval.
Lina (prodops): Customer impact: Jo, can you confirm which customers saw failures and whether any data lost?
Jo (cust-success): No data loss reported. All requests returned 5xx; customers retried. A few high-volume tenants saw brief elevated latency but no persisted errors. I've notified the three impacted accounts and offered post-incident notes.
Amy (oncall): Status update: mitigation in place (flag OFF + rollback). Severity: Sev2 (partial customer impact). Keeping incident open for postmortem and key policy fix.
Ben (sre): I'll keep monitoring for 15m then hand off to Ryan for remediation.
Amy (oncall): Handing off to Ben in 10m, then I'll be offline for a calendar event. If anything degrades ping @Ben directly.
Ben (sre): Taking over. Running health checks and draining any pods still referencing rotated alias. Command used: ```kubectl -n prod get pods -o wide | grep text-gen | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -n1 kubectl -n prod delete pod``` to force recreation on correct config.
Ben (sre): Health checks green. Error rate back to normal for all regions.
Ryan (eng): Draft key policy change (for review): ```{ "Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::111:role/ecsTaskRole","arn:aws:iam::111:role/redwood-service-account"]},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}``` Posting in infra-privsec channel shortly.
Amy (oncall): Add rollout checklist item: verify key policy after rotation and a post-rotation smoke test on canary. Create bug to automate policy copy.
Lina (prodops): Filing incident ticket now with timeline and mitigation steps. Ticket: INC-2204506789.
Jo (cust-success): I'll send a short customer-facing note to impacted accounts mentioning transient errors during deploy and that we've rolled back.
Ben (sre): Proposed follow-ups: 1) fix rotation script to copy policy (owner: Ryan), 2) add automated smoke test for KMS decrypt post-rotation (owner: SRE), 3) add feature-flag kill-switch playbook to runbook (owner: ProdOps).
Ryan (eng): Acknowledged. I'll open the PR for the key policy fix and link to the incident. ETA ~2 hours for PR + review.
Amy (oncall): We'll close the incident once PR is merged and smoke test passes in staging. For now, marking incident state: mitigated. Last observed error: 02:42:25 UTC.
Ben (sre): Final check: metrics OK, no new 5xx spikes in past 12m. I'm comfortable marking resolved pending postmortem.
Amy (oncall): Thanks team. Handing off to Ben for post-incident follow-ups. I'm signing off. :wave:
Ben (sre): Noted. Scheduling postmortem meeting for tomorrow 16:00 UTC and adding owners to the incident ticket.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2204506789 status updated to MITIGATED by Amy. Resolution: rolled back canary + disabled feature flag. Postmortem scheduled.
